enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Fan runs continuously. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out clothes. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread while checking the heatwave forecast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Read forecast. Take bread from toaster. Place on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on toast. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash plate. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing a work bag, refilling a water bottle, and applying sunscreen before leaving
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Pick up water bottle. Walk to kitchen. Fill water bottle from tap. Walk to bathroom. Pick up sunscreen. Apply sunscreen to face. Apply sunscreen to arms. Place sunscreen in bag. Pick up bag. Walk to door. Put on shoes. Open door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office in the morning heat, walking to the bus and train connection
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Get off train. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: answering emails, coordinating community program logistics, and preparing materials for upcoming sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Login. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Pick up documents. Read documents. Write notes. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Walk back to desk. Organize materials. Staple papers. Place materials in folder.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating a packed lunch in the shaded staff area and resting out of the sun
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff area. Sit down. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Bite apple. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw trash in bin. Close lunch bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work: meeting with partner organizations, updating program schedules, and following up with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Open notebook. Take notes. Discuss with partners. Nod head. Write down action items. Walk back to desk. Open computer. Update program schedule. Send emails. Make phone calls. Call volunteers. Update volunteer list. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch arms.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from work during the hottest part of the day, staying in the shade and drinking water
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Drink water. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner on the induction cooker and eating it while the range hood runs to keep the kitchen ventilated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir with spatula. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash plate. Turn off range hood. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, watching a show and cooling down after the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and getting ready for bed, letting the dehumidifier and fan run
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on dehumidifier. Turn on fan. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer on the desk lamp light to read the news and wind down, with the fan on for airflow
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Press power button. Login. Open browser. Read news. Scroll down. Click article. Read article. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn on fan. Lie down on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan circulating air through the night
enriched_activities.desc: Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Fan runs continuously. Continue sleeping.
